response.sql:
WITH vote_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pav.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won / pav.points_max AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE pav.points_max IS NOT NULL 
    AND pav.points_max != 0
    AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(death_country, '') AS country,
    AVG(ratio) AS country_average
  FROM vote_ratios
  GROUP BY COALESCE(death_country, '')
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_mean
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.country,
  ca.country_average,
  ca.country_average / gm.overall_mean AS normalized_average
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.country;

assumptions.assumption: "award-vote record" refers to player_award_vote table; manager_award_vote is an alternative source

alternatives.interpretation: Combine both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote records into a single analysis

WITH vote_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pav.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won / pav.points_max AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE pav.points_max IS NOT NULL 
    AND pav.points_max != 0
    AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    mav.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    mav.points_won::NUMERIC / mav.points_max AS ratio
  FROM manager_award_vote mav
  INNER JOIN player p ON mav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE mav.points_max IS NOT NULL 
    AND mav.points_max != 0
    AND mav.points_won IS NOT NULL
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(death_country, '') AS country,
    AVG(ratio) AS country_average
  FROM vote_ratios
  GROUP BY COALESCE(death_country, '')
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_average) AS overall_mean
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.country,
  ca.country_average,
  ca.country_average / gm.overall_mean AS normalized_average
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.country;
